anchor_evidence_parent_check.name: anchor_evidence_parent_check
anchor_evidence_parent_check.value: ("anchor_evidence"."reply_id" IS NOT NULL)::int + ("anchor_evidence"."dispute_id" IS NOT NULL)::int = 1

anchor_evidence_location_check.name: anchor_evidence_location_check
anchor_evidence_location_check.value: ("anchor_evidence"."kind" = 'link' AND "anchor_evidence"."url" ~ '^https://' AND "anchor_evidence"."storage_reference" IS NULL AND "anchor_evidence"."scan_status" = 'not_required' AND "anchor_evidence"."content_type" IS NULL AND "anchor_evidence"."byte_size" IS NULL AND "anchor_evidence"."sha256" IS NULL AND "anchor_evidence"."scan_result" IS NULL AND "anchor_evidence"."scanned_at" IS NULL) OR ("anchor_evidence"."kind" = 'upload' AND "anchor_evidence"."url" IS NULL AND "anchor_evidence"."storage_reference" ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9][a-zA-Z0-9._:/-]{0,511}$' AND "anchor_evidence"."scan_status" = 'clean' AND "anchor_evidence"."scan_result" IS NOT NULL AND "anchor_evidence"."scanned_at" IS NOT NULL)

anchor_replies_version_link_check.name: anchor_replies_version_link_check
anchor_replies_version_link_check.value: ("anchor_replies"."version" = 1 AND "anchor_replies"."supersedes_reply_id" IS NULL) OR ("anchor_replies"."version" > 1 AND "anchor_replies"."supersedes_reply_id" IS NOT NULL)

assets_type_fields_check.name: assets_type_fields_check
assets_type_fields_check.value:
("assets"."type" = 'native' AND "assets"."code" IS NULL AND "assets"."issuer" IS NULL) OR
          ("assets"."type" = 'credit' AND "assets"."code" IS NOT NULL AND "assets"."issuer" IS NOT NULL)

discrepancy_events_target_required_check.name: discrepancy_events_target_required_check
discrepancy_events_target_required_check.value:
("discrepancy_events"."event_type" IN ('resolved', 'corrected', 'retracted') AND "discrepancy_events"."target_event_id" IS NOT NULL) OR
          ("discrepancy_events"."event_type" NOT IN ('resolved', 'corrected', 'retracted') AND "discrepancy_events"."target_event_id" IS NULL)

ingest_cycles_time_order_check.name: ingest_cycles_time_order_check
ingest_cycles_time_order_check.value:
("ingest_cycles"."started_at" IS NULL OR "ingest_cycles"."started_at" >= "ingest_cycles"."scheduled_at") AND
          ("ingest_cycles"."completed_at" IS NULL OR ("ingest_cycles"."started_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ingest_cycles"."completed_at" >= "ingest_cycles"."started_at"))

ingest_cycles_terminal_state_check.name: ingest_cycles_terminal_state_check
ingest_cycles_terminal_state_check.value:
("ingest_cycles"."status" IN ('completed', 'failed', 'abandoned') AND "ingest_cycles"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR
          ("ingest_cycles"."status" IN ('pending', 'running') AND "ingest_cycles"."completed_at" IS NULL)

notification_delivery_attempts_outcome_c.name: notification_delivery_attempts_outcome_check
notification_delivery_attempts_outcome_c.value:
("notification_delivery_attempts"."outcome" = 'sent' AND "notification_delivery_attempts"."failure" IS NULL) OR
          ("notification_delivery_attempts"."outcome" = 'failed' AND "notification_delivery_attempts"."failure" IS NOT NULL)

notifications_lease_check.name: notifications_lease_check
notifications_lease_check.value:
("notifications"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND "notifications"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL) OR
          ("notifications"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND "notifications"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

reconciliation_snapshots_value_check.name: reconciliation_snapshots_value_check
reconciliation_snapshots_value_check.value:
("reconciliation_snapshots"."status" = 'unavailable' AND "reconciliation_snapshots"."value" IS NULL) OR
          ("reconciliation_snapshots"."status" <> 'unavailable' AND "reconciliation_snapshots"."value" IS NOT NULL)

reconciliation_snapshots_counts_check.name: reconciliation_snapshots_counts_check
reconciliation_snapshots_counts_check.value:
"reconciliation_snapshots"."sources_configured" >= 0 AND "reconciliation_snapshots"."sources_responded" BETWEEN 0 AND "reconciliation_snapshots"."sources_configured" AND
          "reconciliation_snapshots"."sources_usable" BETWEEN 0 AND "reconciliation_snapshots"."sources_responded" AND
          "reconciliation_snapshots"."sources_agreeing" BETWEEN 0 AND "reconciliation_snapshots"."sources_usable" AND
          "reconciliation_snapshots"."sources_excluded" BETWEEN 0 AND "reconciliation_snapshots"."sources_configured"

retrieval_attempts_outcome_error_check.name: retrieval_attempts_outcome_error_check
retrieval_attempts_outcome_error_check.value:
("retrieval_attempts"."outcome" = 'success' AND "retrieval_attempts"."error" IS NULL) OR
          ("retrieval_attempts"."outcome" = 'failure' AND "retrieval_attempts"."error" IS NOT NULL)

scheduled_cycle_leases_job_definition_ch.name: scheduled_cycle_leases_job_definition_check
scheduled_cycle_leases_job_definition_ch.value:
("scheduled_cycle_leases"."job_definition" IS NULL AND "scheduled_cycle_leases"."job_definition_sha256" IS NULL) OR
          ("scheduled_cycle_leases"."job_definition" IS NOT NULL AND "scheduled_cycle_leases"."job_definition_sha256" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')

scheduled_cycle_leases_ownership_check.name: scheduled_cycle_leases_ownership_check
scheduled_cycle_leases_ownership_check.value:
("scheduled_cycle_leases"."status" = 'running' AND "scheduled_cycle_leases"."lease_owner" IS NOT NULL AND
            "scheduled_cycle_leases"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL AND "scheduled_cycle_leases"."heartbeat_at" IS NOT NULL) OR
          ("scheduled_cycle_leases"."status" <> 'running' AND "scheduled_cycle_leases"."lease_owner" IS NULL AND
            "scheduled_cycle_leases"."lease_expires_at" IS NULL AND "scheduled_cycle_leases"."heartbeat_at" IS NULL)

scheduled_cycle_leases_finalization_chec.name: scheduled_cycle_leases_finalization_check
scheduled_cycle_leases_finalization_chec.value:
("scheduled_cycle_leases"."status" = 'completed' AND "scheduled_cycle_leases"."finalized_cycle_id" IS NOT NULL) OR
          ("scheduled_cycle_leases"."status" <> 'completed' AND "scheduled_cycle_leases"."finalized_cycle_id" IS NULL)

source_health_states_circuit_check.name: source_health_states_circuit_check
source_health_states_circuit_check.value:
("source_health_states"."circuit_state" = 'closed' AND "source_health_states"."circuit_opened_at" IS NULL) OR
          ("source_health_states"."circuit_state" = 'open' AND "source_health_states"."circuit_opened_at" IS NOT NULL AND "source_health_states"."next_attempt_at" IS NOT NULL)

source_health_states_healthy_check.name: source_health_states_healthy_check
source_health_states_healthy_check.value:
"source_health_states"."state" <> 'healthy' OR
          ("source_health_states"."consecutive_failures" = 0 AND "source_health_states"."circuit_state" = 'closed' AND
           "source_health_states"."next_attempt_at" IS NULL AND "source_health_states"."last_error_code" IS NULL)
